2023-05-04.title: The +128% deregulation recovery
2023-05-04.body: From the May 2023 crisis low, KRE more than doubled (+128%) into November 2024 — one of the great recovery trades. The healing was mechanical at first: deposits stabilized, NIM bottomed as the rate panic faded, and the survivors proved their books were money-good. Then the November 2024 election added rocket fuel — a deregulation/M&A Trump trade promising lighter capital rules, an easier merger-approval regime, and a long-awaited wave of regional-bank consolidation. The September 2024 Fed cuts eased deposit-cost pressure. From epicenter to leader in eighteen months.
2023-05-04.body_zh: 自2023年5月危机低点起，KRE 翻倍有余（+128%）至2024年11月——堪称伟大的复苏交易之一。康复起初是机械式的：存款企稳，随利率恐慌消退 NIM 见底，幸存者证明其账户资产成色十足。随后2024年11月大选注入火箭燃料——放松监管/并购的特朗普交易，承诺更宽松的资本规则、更易获批的并购机制、以及期待已久的区域银行整合潮。2024年9月美联储降息缓解了存款成本压力。十八个月内，从震中到领涨。
drivers: Deposits stabilized, NIM bottomed as rate panic faded
Survivors proved their loan books money-good
Sep-2024 Fed cuts eased deposit-cost pressure
drivers_zh: 存款企稳、利率恐慌消退后 NIM 见底
幸存者证明贷款账户成色十足
2024年11月大选放松监管/并购特朗普交易
2024年9月美联储降息缓解存款成本压力

2024-11-25.title: Tariff-crash give-back (−30%)
2024-11-25.body: Banks gave back a chunk of the post-election rally into the April 2025 tariff crash. The Trump-trade optimism that had powered them since November ran into the reality of a tariff-driven growth scare — recession odds spiking is the direct enemy of bank credit, and the most economically sensitive group sold off hard. The basket bottomed with the broad market on April 8, 2025.
2024-11-25.body_zh: 随2025年4月关税崩盘，银行回吐了大选后涨幅的相当一部分。自11月以来推动它们的特朗普交易乐观情绪，撞上了关税驱动的增长恐慌现实——衰退概率飙升是银行信用的直接敌人，这一经济最敏感的组别大幅抛售。篮子于2025年4月8日随大盘见底。
drivers: Post-election optimism met tariff growth scare
Recession-odds spike is the direct enemy of bank credit
Most economically sensitive group sold hardest
drivers_zh: 大选后乐观情绪撞上关税增长恐慌
衰退概率飙升是银行信用的直接敌人
经济最敏感组别跌幅最深

2025-04-08.title: The +68% tariff-low-to-now rally
2025-04-08.body: From the April 2025 tariff low, KRE rallied +68% into mid-2026, restoring its Trending status. The recovery rode the market-wide rebound, a renewed deregulation/M&A thrust, and stabilizing NIM. The 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock and Fed hiking bias cut both ways — steeper rates can widen margins, but the inflation/rates combo stresses commercial real estate and credit quality, the perennial regional-bank vulnerability. The mid-June ceasefire took the worst-case tail off. The basket is healthy and mid-range; the thing to watch from here is credit, not deposits.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点起，KRE 上涨+68%至2026年中，重回趋势中状态。复苏借力全市场反弹、放松监管/并购的再度发力、以及企稳的 NIM。2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击与美联储加息倾向双向作用——更陡的利率可拓宽利差，但通胀/利率组合会压力商业地产与信用质量，这是区域银行长期的软肋。6月中旬停火消除了最坏尾部。篮子健康、位置居中；从此往后要盯的是信用，而非存款。
drivers: 2026 oil shock/hiking bias cuts both ways for banks
Watch credit/CRE, not deposits, from here
drivers_zh: 全市场反弹＋放松监管/并购再度发力
企稳的 NIM 重塑趋势中状态
2026年油价冲击/加息倾向对银行双向作用
从此往后盯信用/商业地产，而非存款

big_pharma.now: Big pharma (PPH) is Rolling over at pos 32.4 with weak RS (#31) — the policy-overhang laggard of Healthcare. This basket (Merck, Pfizer, Bristol, AbbVie, J&J; GLP-1 leaders sit in their own obesity basket) carries the heaviest political tax in the market: the May 2025 Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) drug-pricing executive order, which threatens to peg US drug prices to lower foreign benchmarks, plus RFK Jr. at HHS injecting genuine uncertainty into FDA, vaccines, and approval pathways. On top of that sits the structural patent-cliff problem — several mega-blockbusters losing exclusivity this decade — which keeps the group leaning on M&A to refill pipelines. After a long drug-pricing-driven slide into May 2025, the group bid late-2025 as a defensive (cheap, dividend-paying, recession-resistant) but has since rolled back over. It's a value/yield hold with a policy sword hanging over it, not a momentum name.
big_pharma.now_zh: 大型药企（PPH）处于见顶回落，pos 32.4、RS 疲弱（第31位）——医疗板块中受政策压制的落后者。本篮子（Merck、Pfizer、Bristol、AbbVie、J&J；GLP-1 龙头另列减肥药篮子）承担着市场上最重的政治税：2025年5月的最惠国（MFN）药品定价行政令，威胁将美国药价锚定至更低的海外基准；加上小肯尼迪（RFK Jr.）执掌 HHS，为 FDA、疫苗与审批路径注入真实的不确定性。叠加结构性专利悬崖问题——数款超级重磅药本十年将失去独占权——使该组别持续依赖并购来补充管线。在因药品定价拖累、长期下滑至2025年5月后，该组别于2025年末作为防御品（低估值、派息、抗衰退）受到买入，但此后再度回落。这是一个头顶政策利剑的价值/收益持有标的，而非动量品种。

2024-09-16.title: Drug-pricing / policy-overhang slide (−20%)
2024-09-16.title_zh: 药品定价/政策压制下滑（−20%）
2024-09-16.body: From September 2024, big pharma ground down −20% into May 2025 under a thickening policy cloud. The November 2024 election and the incoming administration's drug-pricing agenda, RFK Jr.'s nomination to HHS, and the looming threat of MFN pricing reform all weighed — culminating in the May 2025 Most-Favored-Nation executive order. Layered on top: the structural patent-cliff worry, with several blockbusters facing loss of exclusivity. Even as the broad market wobbled and recovered through the April 2025 tariff episode, pharma's drag was idiosyncratic and policy-driven, not macro.
2024-09-16.body_zh: 自2024年9月起，大型药企在日益浓重的政策阴云下震荡下行−20%至2025年5月。2024年11月大选、新政府的药品定价议程、RFK Jr. 获提名执掌 HHS、以及最惠国（MFN）定价改革的逼近威胁，全部构成压力——最终以2025年5月的最惠国行政令收尾。叠加结构性专利悬崖担忧，数款重磅药面临独占权到期。即便大盘在2025年4月关税事件中震荡又修复，药企的拖累是个体化、政策驱动的，而非宏观。
drivers: RFK Jr. to HHS = FDA/vaccine/approval uncertainty
drivers_zh: RFK Jr. 执掌 HHS＝FDA/疫苗/审批不确定性
结构性专利悬崖独占权到期担忧

2025-05-14.title: Defensive bid / policy-fatigue rally (+42%)
2025-05-14.title_zh: 防御性买盘/政策疲劳反弹（+42%）
2025-05-14.body: From the May 2025 low, big pharma rallied +42% into February 2026 — a recovery built less on growth than on defensiveness and policy fatigue. With the MFN order's actual bite proving slower and more negotiable than feared, the market stopped pricing the worst case. Late-2025 the group caught a genuine defensive bid: cheap valuations, fat dividends, recession-resistant cash flows — exactly the profile investors want when the AI trade gets wobbly and the 2026 oil shock raises macro risk. The basket's Rolling-over phase and weak RS say the rally has since stalled — the policy sword still hangs, and without pipeline catalysts pharma reverts to a value/yield holding pattern.
2025-05-14.body_zh: 自2025年5月低点起，大型药企上涨+42%至2026年2月——这是一场建立在防御性与政策疲劳、而非增长之上的复苏。随着 MFN 行政令的实际杀伤力被证明比担忧的更慢、更可谈判，市场停止定价最坏情形。2025年末该组别获得真正的防御性买盘：低估值、丰厚股息、抗衰退现金流——正是 AI 交易动摇、2026年油价冲击抬高宏观风险时投资者想要的画像。篮子的见顶回落阶段与疲弱 RS 表明该涨势此后停滞——政策利剑仍悬，缺乏管线催化剂时，药企回归价值/收益的横盘格局。
drivers: MFN bite proved slower/more negotiable than feared
Late-2025 defensive bid: cheap, dividends, recession-resistant
Hiding place as AI trade wobbled + 2026 oil shock
Stalled since: policy sword hangs, no pipeline catalyst
drivers_zh: MFN 杀伤力被证明比担忧的更慢、更可谈判
2025年末防御性买盘：低估值、派息、抗衰退
AI 交易动摇＋2026年油价冲击时的避险去处
此后停滞：政策利剑悬挂、缺管线催化剂

obesity_glp1.now: GLP-1 & obesity is Trending at pos 44.1 with strong RS (#13) — the secular super-cycle, now maturing into a competitive war. This is the Eli Lilly / Novo Nordisk story: incretin drugs (Mounjaro/Zepbound, Ozempic/Wegovy) that reshaped metabolic medicine and created one of the largest TAMs in pharma history. The 2025-26 chapter is the pivot from monopoly to oligopoly and from injectable to oral. By late 2025 / early 2026 both giants brought oral pills to market — Novo's oral Wegovy approved first, but Lilly's orforglipron (no food/timing restrictions) is the Street's projected long-run winner. Critically, both agreed to White House pricing deals capping starter-dose orals near $149/month — a pricing reset that trades margin per script for vastly larger volume. The basket also holds the supply chain and the names the drugs hurt (food, dialysis, medical devices). Strong RS says the market still rewards the volume story; the risk is pricing compression and a crowded late-stage pipeline.
obesity_glp1.now_zh: GLP-1 与减肥药处于趋势中，pos 44.1、RS 强劲（第13位）——长期超级周期，如今正成熟为一场竞争战争。这是礼来（Eli Lilly）/诺和诺德（Novo Nordisk）的故事：肠促胰素类药物（Mounjaro/Zepbound、Ozempic/Wegovy）重塑了代谢医学，缔造了制药史上最大的潜在市场（TAM）之一。2025–26 篇章是从垄断到寡头、从注射剂到口服剂的转折。到2025年末/2026年初，两巨头均推出口服丸剂——诺和诺德的口服 Wegovy 率先获批，但礼来的 orforglipron（无饮食/服用时间限制）被华尔街预期为长期赢家。关键是，两家均与白宫达成定价协议，将口服起始剂量封顶在约149美元/月——这是一次以单方处方利润换取远大销量的定价重置。篮子还纳入供应链与被该类药物伤害的标的（食品、透析、医疗器械）。强劲 RS 表明市场仍奖励销量故事；风险在于定价压缩与拥挤的后期管线。

2021-09-02.title: Pre-super-cycle bear (−36%)
2021-09-02.body: Before the obesity narrative exploded, these names traded as ordinary large pharma/biotech and fell ~36% into May 2022 with the 2022 Fed-hiking bear. Lilly and Novo were known quantities (diabetes, established franchises) — the market had not yet grasped that semaglutide and tirzepatide were about to redefine the entire metabolic category. This is the basket as just-pharma, before the re-rating.
2021-09-02.body_zh: 在减肥叙事爆发之前，这些标的作为普通大型药企/生物科技交易，随2022年美联储加息熊市下跌约−36%至2022年5月。礼来与诺和诺德是已知量（糖尿病、成熟特许经营）——市场尚未领悟司美格鲁肽与替尔泊肽即将重新定义整个代谢领域。这是重估之前、作为普通药企的篮子。
drivers: Market had not yet grasped the GLP-1 TAM
drivers_zh: 作为普通大型药企/生物科技交易
随2022年美联储加息熊市下跌
市场尚未领悟 GLP-1 潜在市场

2022-05-11.title: Tirzepatide approval spark (+43%)
2022-05-11.body: The first leg of recognition: Lilly's tirzepatide (Mounjaro) won FDA approval for diabetes in mid-2022 and the weight-loss data was stunning — the market began to see the metabolic super-cycle coming. A +43% rally as the obesity TAM thesis took hold, even as the broad market was still in its 2022 bear.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 认知的第一段：礼来的替尔泊肽（Mounjaro）于2022年中获 FDA 批准用于糖尿病，且减重数据惊人——市场开始预见代谢超级周期的到来。随减肥潜在市场论点确立，出现+43%的上涨，尽管大盘当时仍处2022年熊市。
drivers: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) FDA approval, stunning weight-loss data
Obesity TAM thesis began to take hold
Rallied against the grain of the 2022 bear
drivers_zh: 替尔泊肽（Mounjaro）获 FDA 批准、减重数据惊人
减肥潜在市场论点开始确立

2022-08-15.title: Brief macro pullback (−19%)
2022-08-15.body: A short, shallow give-back into late September 2022 as the broad market made its 2022 bear-market low. Nothing thesis-specific — just the GLP-1 names pulled along by the last leg of the macro selloff before the December 2022 market bottom set up the real bull run.
2022-08-15.body_zh: 随大盘于2022年9月底创下2022年熊市低点，出现短暂而浅的回吐。无关论点本身——只是 GLP-1 标的被宏观抛售的最后一段拖累，随后2022年12月市场触底为真正的牛市铺路。
drivers: Shallow give-back with broad 2022 bear-market low
Set up the real bull run
drivers_zh: 随2022年熊市低点的浅回吐

2022-09-26.title: The +224% obesity super-cycle
2022-09-26.body: The defining leg: from September 2022, the basket exploded +224% into December 2024 as GLP-1 went from clinical promise to cultural and commercial phenomenon. Zepbound's obesity approval, Wegovy's cardiovascular-benefit data, chronic global supply shortages (demand vastly outran manufacturing), and ever-expanding label indications turned Lilly and Novo into two of the most valuable companies on earth. This is one of the great secular growth stories of the decade — a genuinely new drug class creating a multi-hundred-billion-dollar market from scratch.
2022-09-26.body_zh: 决定性行情：自2022年9月起，篮子爆发式上涨+224%至2024年12月，GLP-1 从临床前景跃升为文化与商业现象。Zepbound 获批用于肥胖、Wegovy 的心血管获益数据、长期的全球供应短缺（需求远超产能）、以及不断扩展的适应症标签，把礼来与诺和诺德推上全球市值最高公司之列。这是本十年伟大的长期成长故事之一——一个真正全新的药物类别，从零创造出数千亿美元的市场。
drivers: Zepbound obesity approval + Wegovy CV-benefit data
Lilly/Novo became among the most valuable companies on earth
drivers_zh: Zepbound 获批肥胖＋Wegovy 心血管获益数据
长期全球供应短缺（需求＞产能）
礼来/诺和诺德跻身全球最高市值公司

2024-12-09.title: Policy + tariff drawdown (−28%)
2024-12-09.body: The super-cycle leg met its first real correction into April 2025. The November 2024 election and the incoming drug-pricing agenda (MFN), RFK Jr. at HHS, and disappointing data on a couple of next-gen trials introduced doubt into a heavily-owned, richly-valued group — then the April 8 tariff crash finished the de-risking. The valuation premium that made the super-cycle so powerful on the way up also made it sensitive to any crack in the narrative.
2024-12-09.body_zh: 超级周期行情迎来首次真正调整，至2025年4月。2024年11月大选与新政府药品定价议程（MFN）、RFK Jr. 执掌 HHS、加上几项下一代试验数据令人失望，为这一持仓集中、估值高企的组别注入怀疑——随后4月8日关税崩盘完成了去风险。使超级周期在上行时如此强劲的估值溢价，也使其对叙事的任何裂缝高度敏感。
drivers: RFK Jr. to HHS policy uncertainty
Disappointing next-gen trial data dented the narrative
April-8 tariff crash finished the de-risking
drivers_zh: 2024年11月大选＋MFN 药品定价压制
RFK Jr. 执掌 HHS 的政策不确定性
下一代试验数据令人失望、削弱叙事

2025-04-08.title: The +77% oral-era recovery
2025-04-08.body: From the April 2025 tariff low, the basket rallied +77% into mid-2026, re-establishing strong RS as the story matured from injectable monopoly to oral oligopoly. By late 2025 / early 2026 both giants commercialized obesity pills: Novo's oral Wegovy approved first, Lilly's orforglipron fast-tracked behind it with the convenience edge (no food/timing rules) and the Street's projected long-run lead (~60% of the oral segment by 2030). Both signed White House pricing deals capping starter-dose orals near $149/month — a deliberate margin-for-volume reset that defuses the worst of the MFN pricing threat by getting ahead of it. Strong RS through the 2026 oil shock says the market still treats obesity as a volume/growth story; the watch-items are pricing compression and an increasingly crowded next-gen pipeline (oral, monthly, muscle-sparing entrants).
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点起，篮子上涨+77%至2026年中，随故事从注射剂垄断成熟为口服剂寡头而重建强劲 RS。到2025年末/2026年初，两巨头均将减肥丸剂商业化：诺和诺德的口服 Wegovy 率先获批，礼来的 orforglipron 紧随其后获快速审批，凭借便利优势（无饮食/时间限制）与华尔街预期的长期领先（到2030年约占口服市场60%）。两家均签署白宫定价协议，将口服起始剂量封顶在约149美元/月——一次有意的以利润换销量重置，通过抢先一步化解了 MFN 定价威胁的最坏部分。穿越2026年油价冲击的强劲 RS 表明，市场仍把减肥药视为销量/成长故事；需盯的是定价压缩与日益拥挤的下一代管线（口服、月制剂、保肌型新进入者）。
drivers: Late-2025/early-2026 oral pills: Novo first, Lilly orforglipron leads long-run
White House deals cap starter-dose orals ~$149/month
Margin-for-volume reset gets ahead of MFN threat
Watch: pricing compression + crowded next-gen pipeline
drivers_zh: 2025末/2026初口服丸剂：诺和诺德率先，礼来 orforglipron 长期领先
白宫协议将口服起始剂量封顶约149美元/月
以利润换销量、抢先化解 MFN 威胁
需盯：定价压缩＋拥挤的下一代管线

managed_care.now: Managed care (UNH, Elevance, Cigna, Humana) is the standout of the entire screen — Topping at pos 99.7 (pinned to the top of its range) with RS rank #4. That is a violent recovery from a genuine industry crisis. Through 2025 the medical loss ratio blew out: seniors used outpatient surgery and high-cost GLP-1 drugs far above actuarial assumptions while Medicare Advantage funding was cut, pushing UNH's medical care ratio to ~88.9% and its 2025 net profit down ~16%. The stock and the whole MA cohort cratered. The turn came when 2026 economics stabilized — Q1 2026 MCR improved to ~83.9%, UNH raised guidance, and CMS finalized favorable 2027 MA rates (~2.48%), with the Street modeling a sharp MA-EBIT rebound off pricing resets. The result is the +73% rally into mid-2026 that left the basket pinned at the top. The honest read: the recovery is real, but pos 99.7 + Topping is exactly where you respect the move and watch for exhaustion — the easy repricing is done, and utilization/policy risk never fully leaves this group.
managed_care.now_zh: 管理式医疗（UNH、Elevance、Cigna、Humana）是整张筛选表的标杆——见顶，pos 99.7（贴在区间顶部）、RS 第4位。这是从一场真正的行业危机中的暴力复苏。2025年全年医疗损失率（MLR）失控：老年人使用门诊手术与高价 GLP-1 药物的频率远超精算假设，同时 Medicare Advantage（MA）资金被削减，使 UNH 的医疗成本率升至约88.9%、2025年净利润下降约16%。该股与整个 MA 群组暴跌。转折出现在2026年经济性企稳时——2026年一季度 MCR 改善至约83.9%、UNH 上调指引、且 CMS 敲定了有利的2027年 MA 费率（约2.48%），华尔街据定价重置建模出 MA-EBIT 的急剧反弹。结果是涨至2026年中的+73%行情，使篮子贴在顶部。诚实的解读：复苏是真实的，但 pos 99.7＋见顶恰恰是应当尊重涨势、警惕衰竭的位置——容易的重估已经完成，而利用率/政策风险从未真正离开这一组别。

2021-05-28.title: 2021-22 defensive de-rate (−21%)
2021-05-28.body: Managed care drifted −21% into January 2022, a relatively mild drawdown for the start of the 2022 cycle — health insurers are defensive, recession-resistant cash machines, so they held up better than growth as the Fed turned hawkish. The MCO model (collect premiums, manage the medical-loss ratio, keep the spread) is countercyclical-ish, and that defensiveness is the through-line of the whole basket's history.
2021-05-28.body_zh: 管理式医疗震荡下行−21%至2022年1月，对2022年周期开端而言是相对温和的回撤——健康保险公司是防御性、抗衰退的现金机器，因此在美联储转鹰时比成长股更抗跌。MCO 模式（收保费、管理医疗损失率、赚取价差）略带逆周期性，而这种防御性是整个篮子历史的主线。
drivers: Held up better than growth as Fed turned hawkish
drivers_zh: 防御性、抗衰退的现金机器
美联储转鹰时比成长股更抗跌
MCO 的保费减 MLR 价差略带逆周期

2022-01-27.title: Inflation-bear defensive bid (+28%)
2022-01-27.body: A +28% rally into April 2022 as capital rotated into defensives during the early 2022 inflation/rate scare. With growth stocks unraveling, the steady, dividend-paying, recession-resistant MCOs were exactly where investors hid — the first of several times this basket plays the safe-haven role.
2022-01-27.body_zh: 随2022年初通胀/利率恐慌期间资金轮入防御股，出现+28%上涨至2022年4月。在成长股瓦解之际，稳健、派息、抗衰退的 MCO 正是投资者的避险去处——这是本篮子多次扮演避风港角色中的第一次。
drivers: Capital rotated into defensives during inflation scare
drivers_zh: 通胀恐慌期间资金轮入防御股
成长股瓦解时的避险买盘
多次避风港行情中的第一次

2022-04-20.title: Macro pullback (−18%)
2022-04-20.body: A shallow −18% give-back into June 2022 alongside the broad market's mid-2022 leg lower. No MCO-specific catalyst — just defensives getting pulled into the general 2022 selloff before resuming their relative outperformance.
2022-04-20.body_zh: 随大盘2022年中段下行，出现浅幅−18%回吐至2022年6月。无关 MCO 本身的催化剂——只是防御股被卷入2022年的整体抛售，随后恢复相对超额表现。
drivers: Shallow give-back with broad mid-2022 selloff
drivers_zh: 随大盘2022年中段抛售的浅回吐
无关 MCO 本身的催化剂
防御股被卷入整体避险
之后恢复相对超额表现

2022-06-16.title: Defensive leadership rally (+31%)
2022-06-16.body: A +31% surge into August 2022 as managed care led the defensive trade through the heart of the 2022 bear. While tech bled, MCOs printed steady earnings and the safe-haven premium widened — the group's relative strength peaked around here before a long 2022-23 consolidation set in.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 随管理式医疗在2022年熊市核心阶段领跑防御交易，出现+31%飙升至2022年8月。科技流血之际，MCO 录得稳定盈利、避险溢价扩大——该组别的相对强度在此附近见顶，随后进入漫长的2022–23盘整。
drivers: Led the defensive trade through the 2022 bear
Relative strength peaked before long consolidation
drivers_zh: 在2022年熊市中领跑防御交易
科技流血时录得稳定盈利
相对强度见顶后进入长盘整

2022-08-15.title: Defensives unwind into genAI risk-on (−27%)
2022-08-15.title_zh: 防御股向生成式AI风险偏好的解仓（−27%）
2022-08-15.body: Managed care fell −27% into March 2023 — the mirror image of its 2022 strength. As the December 2022 market low gave way to the early-2023 genAI risk-on rally, capital rotated OUT of defensives and INTO growth and tech. When the market wants beta, the safe-haven MCOs become a source of funds. The bottom in March 2023 coincided with the SVB crisis peak-fear moment.
2022-08-15.body_zh: 管理式医疗下跌−27%至2023年3月——其2022年强势的镜像。随2022年12月市场低点让位于2023年初的生成式 AI 风险偏好行情，资金从防御股轮出、流入成长与科技。当市场追逐 beta 时，避险型 MCO 成为资金来源。2023年3月的底部恰逢 SVB 危机的恐慌峰值时刻。
drivers: Capital rotated out of defensives into genAI growth
Safe-haven MCOs became a source of funds
Bottomed at the March-2023 SVB peak-fear
drivers_zh: 资金从防御股轮出、流入生成式 AI 成长
避险型 MCO 成为资金来源
于2023年3月 SVB 恐慌峰值见底

2023-03-23.title: The +57% pre-crisis bull (Mar '23 → Sep '24)
2023-03-23.body: A long, steady +57% climb into September 2024. Strong enrollment, disciplined medical-cost management, and Medicare Advantage growth drove durable earnings as the broad market chased AI. This is the last normal uptrend before the 2025 crisis — the calm that preceded the medical-loss-ratio blowout, ending right at the September 2024 peak as the first cracks in MA economics appeared.
2023-03-23.body_zh: 稳健的长升浪，+57%至2024年9月。强劲的参保人数、严格的医疗成本管理、以及 Medicare Advantage 增长驱动了持久盈利，而大盘当时在追逐 AI。这是2025年危机前最后一段正常上行趋势——医疗损失率失控前的平静，在2024年9月高点结束，恰逢 MA 经济性首批裂缝显现之际。
drivers: Medicare Advantage growth drove durable earnings
Last normal uptrend before the 2025 crisis
Ended at Sep-2024 peak as first MA cracks appeared
drivers_zh: 强劲参保＋严格医疗成本管理
Medicare Advantage 增长驱动持久盈利
2025年危机前最后一段正常上行
于2024年9月高点结束，MA 首批裂缝显现

2024-09-13.title: First MA-cost crack (−23%)
2024-09-13.body: The first leg down of the crisis: −23% into December 2024 as Medicare Advantage cost trends started running hot and a near-flat preliminary MA rate proposal landed. The market began to grasp that utilization — outpatient procedures, and increasingly expensive GLP-1 prescriptions — was overrunning the actuarial assumptions baked into premiums. The defensive armor was cracking.
2024-09-13.body_zh: 危机的第一段下跌：−23%至2024年12月，Medicare Advantage 成本趋势开始升温、近乎持平的初步 MA 费率提案落地。市场开始领悟，利用率——门诊手术、以及日益昂贵的 GLP-1 处方——正在压垮内置于保费中的精算假设。防御铠甲正在开裂。
drivers: Medicare Advantage cost trends started running hot
drivers_zh: Medicare Advantage 成本趋势开始升温
近乎持平的初步 MA 费率提案
利用率（门诊＋GLP-1）压垮精算假设

2024-12-17.title: Pre-tariff relief bounce (+29%)
2024-12-17.body: A +29% bounce into April 2025 as the market hoped the cost trend was a one-off and the final MA rate would prove better than the flat proposal. The optimism was premature — the leg ended right at the April 2025 tariff-crash window, just before UNH's guidance cut would reveal the cost problem was far worse and structural, not transitory.
2024-12-17.body_zh: 随市场期望成本趋势只是一次性、且最终 MA 费率会好于持平提案，出现+29%反弹至2025年4月。这份乐观为时过早——该行情恰在2025年4月关税崩盘窗口结束，就在 UNH 的指引下调揭示成本问题远更严重且为结构性、而非暂时性之前。
drivers: Hope cost trend was one-off, final MA rate better than proposal
Before UNH guidance cut revealed structural cost problem
drivers_zh: 期望成本趋势是一次性、最终 MA 费率优于提案
于2025年4月关税崩盘窗口结束
UNH 指引下调揭示结构性成本问题之前

2025-04-11.title: The crisis capitulation (−33%)
2025-04-11.body: The deepest leg of the crisis: −33% into August 2025. UNH cut guidance and the market finally priced the full severity — the medical care ratio blowing out toward ~88.9%, full-year 2025 net profit down ~16%, the cost overrun confirmed as industry-wide rather than company-specific. GLP-1 utilization (the obesity-drug super-cycle, ironically) was itself a major cost driver. Berkshire's later stake exit and a leadership/regulatory cloud over UNH deepened the gloom. This was genuine capitulation in what had been Healthcare's safest group.
2025-04-11.body_zh: 危机最深的一段：−33%至2025年8月。UNH 下调指引，市场终于定价完整严重程度——医疗成本率向约88.9%失控、2025全年净利润下降约16%、成本超支被确认为全行业而非单一公司问题。具讽刺意味的是，GLP-1 利用率（减肥药超级周期本身）正是主要成本驱动因素之一。伯克希尔后来退出持股、加上 UNH 的领导层/监管阴云加深了悲观。这是曾经医疗板块最安全组别中真正的投降。
drivers: UNH guidance cut; MCR blew out toward ~88.9%
Full-year 2025 net profit down ~16%, cost overrun industry-wide
GLP-1 utilization itself a major cost driver
Berkshire stake exit + UNH leadership/regulatory cloud
drivers_zh: UNH 下调指引；MCR 向约88.9%失控
2025全年净利润下降约16%，成本超支全行业
GLP-1 利用率本身是主要成本驱动
伯克希尔退出持股＋UNH 领导层/监管阴云

2025-08-01.title: First recovery bounce (+37%)
2025-08-01.body: A sharp +37% snapback into October 2025 — the first sign the worst was priced. Bombed-out valuations, early evidence that 2026 repricing (insurers raising premiums and tightening benefits to restore margin) would fix the spread, and a sense that the capitulation had overshot drove an oversold rally in the most beaten-down group in Healthcare.
2025-08-01.body_zh: 急速回升+37%至2025年10月——最坏情形已被定价的第一个迹象。被打入谷底的估值、2026年重定价（保险公司提高保费、收紧福利以恢复利润）将修复价差的早期证据、以及投降已超调的感觉，共同驱动了医疗板块跌得最惨组别的超卖反弹。
drivers: First sign the worst was priced; bombed-out valuations
Early evidence 2026 repricing would restore the spread
Oversold rally in Healthcare's most beaten-down group
drivers_zh: 最坏已被定价的首个迹象；谷底估值
2026年重定价将恢复价差的早期证据
医疗板块跌得最惨组别的超卖反弹

2025-10-08.title: Choppy bottoming dip (−18%)
2025-10-08.body: A −18% pullback into November 2025 — a normal retest as the recovery digested. The 2026 setup wasn't fully confirmed yet (rates, MCR trajectory, guidance all still in question), so the bounce gave back ground before the durable turn. Part of the bottoming process, not a new down-leg.
2025-10-08.body_zh: 回调−18%至2025年11月——复苏消化期间的正常回踩。2026年的格局尚未完全确认（费率、MCR 轨迹、指引均存疑），故反弹在持久转折前回吐了部分涨幅。这是筑底过程的一部分，而非新的下跌段。
drivers: Gave back ground before the durable turn
Part of bottoming, not a new down-leg
drivers_zh: 复苏消化期间的正常回踩
2026年格局尚未完全确认（费率/MCR/指引）
持久转折前回吐部分涨幅
筑底的一部分、非新下跌段

2025-11-20.title: Confirmation rally (+25%)
2025-11-20.body: A +25% leg into January 2026 as the 2026-recovery thesis firmed up. Signs that the medical-cost trend was peaking and that insurers' repricing would stick gave the market conviction the trough earnings were in. The group started reclaiming its defensive-leadership mantle as the broader market grappled with the building 2026 oil-shock/inflation backdrop.
2025-11-20.body_zh: 随2026年复苏论点夯实，出现+25%上涨至2026年1月。医疗成本趋势见顶、保险公司重定价将站稳的迹象，给了市场盈利低点已现的信心。在大盘应对正在累积的2026年油价冲击/通胀背景之际，该组别开始重拾防御领导地位。
drivers: Medical-cost trend peaking + repricing would stick
Reclaiming defensive leadership amid building oil-shock backdrop
drivers_zh: 医疗成本趋势见顶＋重定价站稳
在累积的油价冲击背景中重拾防御领导

2026-01-15.title: Oil-shock-window dip (−26%)
2026-01-15.body: A −26% drawdown into March 2026, overlapping the worst of the 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock (CPI 4.2%, Fed hiking bias). Even a defensive group gets caught in a broad risk-off when inflation spikes and the Fed turns hawkish — and after a big recovery run, managed care was a profit-taking target. This proved to be the launchpad for the final, biggest leg up.
2026-01-15.body_zh: 回撤−26%至2026年3月，与2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击最严重时期（CPI 4.2%、美联储加息倾向）重叠。即便防御组别，在通胀飙升、美联储转鹰的整体避险中也难以幸免——且在一轮大幅复苏之后，管理式医疗成为获利了结的目标。这后来证明是最后、也是最大一段上行的发射台。
drivers: Overlapped worst of 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock (CPI 4.2%)
Even defensives caught in inflation-spike risk-off
Launchpad for the final, biggest leg up
drivers_zh: 与2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击最严重期重叠（CPI 4.2%）
通胀飙升避险中即便防御股也难幸免
大幅复苏后的获利了结
最后、最大一段上行的发射台

2026-03-30.title: The +73% recovery blow-off
2026-03-30.body: The capstone: +73% from the March 2026 low into mid-2026, the leg that pinned the basket at the top of its range (pos 99.7, RS #4). The 2026 economics were now confirmed in the print — Q1 2026 MCR improving to ~83.9%, UNH raising 2026 EPS guidance, and CMS finalizing favorable 2027 MA rates (~2.48%) with the Street modeling a sharp MA-EBIT rebound off the pricing resets. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire removed the macro tail and let the recovery run clean. The honest caveat: Topping at pos 99.7 means the easy repricing is done — respect the move, but utilization and policy risk never fully leave this group, and this is exactly where you watch for exhaustion rather than chase.
2026-03-30.body_zh: 收官之作：自2026年3月低点起+73%至2026年中，正是这段行情把篮子钉在区间顶部（pos 99.7、RS 第4位）。2026年的经济性如今已在财报中确认——一季度 MCR 改善至约83.9%、UNH 上调2026年 EPS 指引、CMS 敲定有利的2027年 MA 费率（约2.48%），华尔街据定价重置建模出 MA-EBIT 的急剧反弹。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火消除了宏观尾部，让复苏得以干净地推进。诚实的提醒：pos 99.7 处见顶意味着容易的重估已经完成——尊重涨势，但利用率与政策风险从未真正离开这一组别，这恰恰是该警惕衰竭、而非追涨的位置。
drivers: Q1-2026 MCR improved to ~83.9%, UNH raised guidance
Street modeled sharp MA-EBIT rebound off pricing resets
Mid-June Hormuz ceasefire removed macro tail; watch exhaustion at pos 99.7
drivers_zh: 2026一季度 MCR 改善至约83.9%、UNH 上调指引
CMS 敲定有利的2027年 MA 费率（约2.48%）
华尔街据定价重置建模 MA-EBIT 急剧反弹
6月中旬霍尔木兹停火消除宏观尾部；pos 99.7 处警惕衰竭

housing.now: The housing chain (XHB-proxied builders DHI/LEN, Home Depot and building-products names) sits mid-pack (pos 40, RS rank 17) and is grinding higher again after a rough start to 2026. The thesis here is one thing above all else: mortgage rates. When the Fed leaned hawkish into the Iran/Hormuz oil shock and CPI ran hot at 4.2% earlier in 2026, the 30-year mortgage backed up and builders sold off ~25% into May. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire and cooling pump prices have let rates ease at the margin, and homebuilders have bounced ~22% off the May low. This is a rate-relief rally, not a demand boom — affordability is still stretched and the group is hostage to the next CPI print and the Fed's reaction to it.
housing.now_zh: 住房产业链（以XHB为代理，包括房屋建筑商DHI/LEN、家得宝及建筑产品公司）处于中游位置（位置40，RS排名17），在经历了2026年初的艰难开局后再次震荡走高。这里的主题首先取决于一件事：抵押贷款利率。2026年初美联储在伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击下转向鹰派、CPI高达4.2%时，30年期抵押贷款利率回升，房屋建筑商在到5月之前下跌约25%。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火以及油价回落让利率边际回落，房屋建筑商从5月低点反弹约22%。这是利率减压反弹，而非需求爆发——购房负担能力依然紧张，该板块受制于下一个CPI数据及美联储的反应。

2021-12-31.title: Rate-hike bear: mortgage shock cracks builders
2021-12-31.body: Builders fell ~38% in the first half of 2022 as the Fed began its most aggressive hiking cycle in decades. The 30-year mortgage rate roughly doubled toward 6%, demand froze, and the entire housing chain — from DHI/LEN to Home Depot — de-rated on collapsing affordability.
drivers: Buyer demand freezes on affordability shock
Building-products and big-box names de-rate together
2021-12-31.title_zh: 加息熊市：抵押贷款冲击击垮建筑商
2021-12-31.body_zh: 随着美联储启动几十年来最激进的加息周期，房屋建筑商在2022年上半年下跌约38%。30年期抵押贷款利率几乎翻倍接近6%，需求冻结，从DHI/LEN到家得宝的整个住房产业链都因购房负担能力崩塌而估值下调。
drivers_zh: 美联储启动激进加息周期
购房负担能力冲击下需求冻结
建筑产品与大卖场同步估值下调

2022-06-16.title: Summer bear-market bounce
2022-06-16.body: A ~26% relief rally ran from the June 2022 low into mid-August as bond yields paused and the market priced a Fed pivot that never came. Housing, the most rate-sensitive group, led the snap-back before the Jackson Hole hawkish reset ended it.
drivers: Market prices a premature Fed pivot
Oversold technical reflex after a 38% drop
2022-06-16.body_zh: 从2022年6月低点到8月中旬，随着债券收益率暂停、市场提前定价一次未能兼现的美联储转向，出现约26%的反弹。作为对利率最敏感的板块，住房在杰克逊霍尔鹰派重置结束这轮反弹前引领反弹。
drivers_zh: 债券收益率暂停，10年期回落
市场提前定价美联储转向
利率敏感板块引领反弹

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole reset: second leg down
2022-08-16.body: A ~20% selloff into late October as Powell's hawkish Jackson Hole speech killed pivot hopes and mortgage rates pushed past 7%. Housing made its cycle low alongside the broad equity bottom.
drivers: Pivot hopes erased, yields make new highs
2022-08-16.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔重置：第二轮下跌
2022-08-16.body_zh: 随着鲍尔的杰克逊霍尔鹰派讲话打死转向希望、抵押贷款利率突破7%，该板块到10月下旬下跌约20%。住房与大盘股票同步触及周期低点。
drivers_zh: 鲍尔杰克逊霍尔鹰派讲话
转向希望抹去，收益率创新高

2022-10-20.title: Peak-rates rally: builders front-run the cut
2022-10-20.body: A powerful ~78% surge from the October 2022 low through August 2023. With the Fed nearing the end of its hikes, homebuilders — which trade on the second derivative of rates, not the level — front-ran the eventual easing even before mortgage rates fell, supported by resilient new-build demand amid a frozen resale market.
drivers: Fed nears the end of its hiking cycle
Builders trade on rate direction, not level
Frozen resale market funnels demand to new builds
2022-10-20.title_zh: 利率见顶反弹：建筑商提前定价降息
2022-10-20.body_zh: 从2022年10月低点到2023年8月强劲上涨约78%。随着美联储接近加息尾声，交易逻辑取决于利率二阶导数而非绝对水平的房屋建筑商，甚至在抵押贷款利率下降之前就提前定价最终的宽松，同时冻结的二手房市场支撑了弹性的新房需求。
drivers_zh: 美联储接近加息周期尾声
建筑商交易取决于利率方向而非水平
冻结的二手房市场将需求导向新房
2023年软着陆与AI主导的风险偏好背景

2023-08-07.title: Yield spike scare
2023-08-07.body: A ~20% pullback into late October 2023 as the 10-year Treasury yield ran toward 5% and the 30-year mortgage touched ~8% — the highest in two decades. The most rate-sensitive group gave back a chunk before the year-end pivot rally.
2023-08-07.body_zh: 随着10年期国债收益率趋向5%、30年期抵押贷款利率触及约8%（二十年最高），该板块到2023年10月下旬回调约20%。在年底转向反弹前，这个最对利率敏感的板块吐出了一部分涨幅。
drivers_zh: 购房负担能力跌至二十年最差
利率敏感板块引领回调

2023-10-25.title: Pivot rally to all-time highs
2023-10-25.body: A ~90% rip from the October 2023 low through October 2024. The Fed's dovish December 2023 pivot, falling yields and the actual September 2024 rate cut sent builders to record highs, with chronic under-supply of existing homes keeping new-build order books full.
drivers: Yields fall, mortgage rates roll over
Chronic existing-home undersupply props up new builds
2023-10-25.body_zh: 从2023年10月低点到2024年10月暴涨约90%。美联储2023年12月鸽派转向、收益率下行以及2024年9月实际降息，送建筑商创下记录新高，二手房长期供给不足让新房订单保持饱满。
drivers_zh: 收益率下行，抵押贷款利率见顶
二手房长期供给不足支撑新房

2024-10-18.title: Higher-for-longer plus tariff shock
2024-10-18.body: A ~34% slide from the October 2024 peak into the April 8, 2025 low. Sticky inflation pushed yields back up and 'higher-for-longer' returned, then the April 2025 reciprocal-tariff crash hammered building-products costs and broad risk appetite, dragging the whole chain down with the market.
2024-10-18.title_zh: 高利率更久叠加关税冲击
2024-10-18.body_zh: 从2024年10月高点到2025年4月8日低点下滑约34%。顽固的通胀推高收益率、“高利率更久”回归，随后2025年4月对等关税暴跌重创建筑产品成本与整体风险偏好，拖累整个产业链随大盘下跌。
drivers_zh: 顽固通胀重启“高利率更久”
抵押贷款利率重新趋向7%
关税推高建筑产品投入成本

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff recovery
2025-04-08.body: A ~37% rebound off the April 2025 tariff low into September as the worst-case tariff scenarios were dialed back and rate-cut hopes revived. Builders recovered with the broad market, though affordability remained the persistent overhang.
drivers: Builders rebound with the broad market
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月关税低点到9月反弹约37%，随着最坏情况的关税场景被下调、降息希望重振。建筑商随大盘复苏，但购房负担能力仍是持续的压制因素。
drivers_zh: 关税降温缓解投入成本担忧
购房负担能力仍是持续上限

2025-09-08.title: Autumn fade as rate optimism stalls
2025-09-08.body: A ~20% pullback into late November 2025 as the rate-cut path stalled and the economy showed late-cycle wear. The most rate-sensitive group gave back its summer gains ahead of the 2026 inflation scare.
2025-09-08.title_zh: 秋季回落：利率乐观停滞
2025-09-08.body_zh: 随着降息路径停滞、经济显现周期末期疲态，该板块到2025年11月下旬回调约20%。在迎接2026年通胀惊魂前，这个最对利率敏感的板块吐回了夏季涨幅。
drivers_zh: 利率敏感板块引领回落

2025-11-20.title: Year-end seasonal bounce
2025-11-20.body: A ~25% rally into February 2026 on a calmer rate backdrop and a typical late-year recovery, before the Iran/Hormuz oil shock reset the inflation picture and undid it.
drivers: Rally cut short by the 2026 oil shock
2025-11-20.body_zh: 在较为平静的利率背景与典型的年末复苏下，该板块到2026年2月反弹约25%，随后伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击重置了通胀图景并终结了这轮反弹。
drivers_zh: 年末利率背景较为平静
反弹被2026年石油冲击打断

2026-02-11.title: Oil-shock inflation scare
2026-02-11.body: A ~25% selloff into mid-May 2026 as the Iran/Hormuz oil shock pushed gasoline higher, CPI to 4.2% and the Fed back into hiking mode. The 30-year mortgage backed up again and housing, the front-line rate-sensitive group, sold off hard.
drivers: Iran/Hormuz oil shock lifts gasoline and CPI to 4.2%
Fed shifts back into hiking mode
2026-02-11.body_zh: 随着伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击推高汽油价格、CPI升至4.2%、美联储重返加息模式，该板块到2026年5月中旬下跌约25%。30年期抵押贷款利率再次回升，作为一线利率敏感板块的住房重挫。
drivers_zh: 伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击推高汽油与CPI至4.2%
30年期抵押贷款利率再次回升
一线利率敏感性驱动下跌

2026-05-19.title: Ceasefire rate-relief bounce
2026-05-19.body: A ~23% rebound off the May 2026 low. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire and easing pump prices took the tail risk out of inflation, letting mortgage rates ease at the margin and giving the most beaten-down rate-sensitive group a sharp reflex rally. This is rate relief, not a demand boom — the group remains hostage to the next CPI print.
drivers: Mid-June Hormuz ceasefire eases inflation tail risk
Gasoline prices cool, easing CPI pressure
Mortgage rates ease at the margin
Sharp reflex rally off a deeply oversold low
2026-05-19.body_zh: 从2026年5月低点反弹约23%。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火与油价回落消除了通胀尾部风险，让抵押贷款利率边际回落，为这个跌幅最深的利率敏感板块带来强劲的反弹。这是利率减压而非需求爆发——该板块仍受制于下一个CPI数据。
drivers_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹停火缓解通胀尾部风险
汽油价格回落，缓解CPI压力
抵押贷款利率边际回落
深度超卖低点后的强劲反弹

retail.now: Retail (XLY-proxied big-box and off-price — Walmart, Costco, Target, plus discretionary) is the weakest theme on the board (pos 16, RS rank 30) and is trying to base. The group's story is the health of the US consumer, and 2026 has been unkind to it: the Iran/Hormuz oil shock pushed gasoline and CPI to 4.2%, squeezing real wages exactly where this basket lives. Import-heavy discount retail also wears the tariff cost — the April 2025 reciprocal tariffs hit landed-goods margins, echoing the 2022 inventory/margin shock that blew up Walmart and Target. Defensive staples like Walmart and Costco hold up better than discretionary names. The basket is bottoming, not breaking out — a real turn needs the consumer to get relief from cooling gas prices and an end to the rate-hike pressure.
retail.now_zh: 零售（以XLY为代理的大卖场与低价零售——沃尔玛、好市多、塔吉特，加上可选消费）是板上最弱的主题（位置16，RS排名30），正试图筑底。该板块的故事是美国消费者的健康状况，而2026年对它并不友好：伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击推高汽油价格与CPI至4.2%，恰好挤压了该篩子所在的实际工资。进口为主的折扣零售还承担关税成本——2025年4月对等关税冲击到到岸商品利润率，呼应了2022年引爆沃尔玛和塔吉特的库存/利润率冲击。沃尔玛、好市多这类防御性必需品表现优于可选消费。这个篩子正在筑底而非突破——真正的转向需要汽油价格回落让消费者获得缓解以及加息压力结束。

2021-11-18.title: Early rate-hike de-rate
2021-11-18.body: Retail fell ~18% from the late-2021 peak as the Fed signaled the end of easy money. Multiples compressed as the market braced for higher rates and slowing discretionary spend.
drivers: Fed signals end of easy money
2021-11-18.body_zh: 随着美联储预示宽松货币终结，零售从2021年底高点下跌约18%。随着市场为更高利率与放缓的可选消费做准备，估值压缩。
drivers_zh: 美联储预示宽松货币终结
市场为更高利率做准备

2022-02-23.title: Reopening-demand bounce
2022-02-23.body: A ~19% rally into April 2022 as still-strong consumer demand and reopening spending temporarily outweighed rate fears, before the margin shock arrived.
2022-02-23.body_zh: 从2022年4月反弹约19%，仍然强劲的消费需求与重启支出暂时盖过利率担忧，随后利润率冲击降临。

2022-04-20.title: The 2022 margin shock
2022-04-20.body: A brutal ~24% plunge in a month as Walmart and Target both missed badly on earnings — bloated post-COVID inventory, surging freight and labor costs and weakening discretionary demand crushed margins. It was the defining retail event of the cycle.
drivers: Walmart and Target miss earnings badly
2022-04-20.body_zh: 随着沃尔玛和塔吉特财报双双大幅不及预期——疫后库存臃肿、运费和人工成本骤升、可选需求转弱压垮利润率——该板块在一个月内猛跌约24%。这是本轮周期决定性的零售事件。
drivers_zh: 沃尔玛和塔吉特财报大幅不及预期

2022-05-20.title: Long grind off the margin low
2022-05-20.body: A ~42% recovery from the May 2022 low through April 2023. After clearing excess inventory, retailers normalized margins, the consumer proved more resilient than feared, and a soft-landing narrative took hold into 2023.
drivers: Consumer proves more resilient than feared
2022-05-20.title_zh: 从利润率低点的长期震荡上行
2022-05-20.body_zh: 从2022年5月低点到2023年4月复苏约42%。清理过剩库存后，零售商利润率正常化，消费者表现比担忧的更有韧性，软着陆叙事进入2023年。
drivers_zh: 过剩库存清理，利润率正常化
消费者比担忧的更有韧性
低价与折扣零售商引领

2023-04-24.title: Mid-cycle consumer wobble
2023-04-24.body: A ~15% pullback into late October 2023 as the yield spike, restarting student-loan payments and 'higher-for-longer' rate fears hit consumer-spending sentiment.
2023-04-24.body_zh: 随着收益率骤升、学生贷款还款重启以及“高利率更久”担忧冲击消费情绪，该板块到2023年10月下旬回调约15%。
drivers_zh: 收益率骤升压制可选消费

2023-10-27.title: Soft-landing rally
2023-10-27.body: A ~42% advance from the October 2023 low into December 2024. Falling inflation, resilient employment, the Fed pivot and the September 2024 rate cut powered a broad consumer rally; Walmart and Costco led on share gains and steady traffic.
drivers: Fed pivot and September 2024 rate cut
2023-10-27.body_zh: 从2023年10月低点到2024年12月上涨约42%。通胀下行、就业有韧性、美联储转向及2024年9月降息推动广泛的消费反弹；沃尔玛和好市多凭市场份额增长与稳定客流领涨。
drivers_zh: 通胀下行与就业有韧性
美联储转向与2024年9月降息
沃尔玛和好市多市场份额增长

2024-12-11.title: Tariff-shock selloff
2024-12-11.body: A ~16% slide into the April 8, 2025 low. Import-heavy discount retail is squarely in the tariff crosshairs, and the April 2025 reciprocal tariffs threatened to raise landed costs on goods sourced abroad, hitting margins and consumer sentiment together.
2024-12-11.body_zh: 从2025年4月8日低点下滑约16%。进口为主的折扣零售正处于关税靶心，2025年4月对等关税威胁推高海外采购商品的到岸成本，同时冲击利润率与消费情绪。
drivers_zh: 进口为主的零售推高到岸成本
利润率与情绪同时受冲

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff relief recovery
2025-04-08.body: A ~48% rebound off the April 2025 tariff low into February 2026 as tariff fears eased and the consumer held up better than the worst-case scenarios feared. Walmart and Costco led on defensive resilience; the rally then ran into the 2026 oil-shock inflation squeeze.
drivers: Consumer holds up better than feared
Walmart and Costco lead on resilience
Rally caps into the 2026 oil shock
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税冲击后的缓解复苏
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月关税低点到2026年2月反弹约48%，随着关税担忧缓解、消费者表现优于最坏场景。沃尔玛和好市多凭防御性韧性领涨；这轮反弹随后撞上2026年石油冲击的通胀挤压。
drivers_zh: 关税降温缓解利润率担忧
沃尔玛和好市多凭韧性领涨

travel.now: Travel & experiences (JETS-proxied airlines, cruises, lodging and gaming) is topping (pos 78, RS rank 11) after a long post-COVID run. From the April 2025 low the basket has rallied ~78% on resilient experiential spending, full planes and strong cruise bookings — but it is now extended and consumer-cyclical, exactly the wrong profile if the 2026 oil-shock inflation squeeze (gasoline up, CPI 4.2%) erodes discretionary budgets and jet-fuel costs bite airline margins. The reopening trade is mature; the question now is whether the consumer can keep funding experiences as real incomes are pinched. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire helps on fuel, but the group's risk/reward has shifted from 'catch-up' to 'late-cycle.'
travel.now_zh: 旅游与体验（以JETS为代理的航空、邮轮、住宿与博彩）在经历漫长的疫后上涨后正在见顶（位置78，RS排名11）。从2025年4月低点，该篩子凭体验型消费的韧性、满舱的航班与强劲的邮轮预订反弹约78%——但如今已超买且属于消费周期型，如果2026年石油冲击的通胀挤压（汽油上涨、CPI 4.2%）侵蚀可选预算、喷气燃油成本拖累航空公司利润率，这恰恰是错误的定位。重启交易已进入成熟阶段；现在的问题是在实际收入受挤下消费者能否继续为体验买单。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火在燃油方面有所帮助，但该板块的风险回报已从“补涨”转向“周期末期”。

2020-06-26.title: Reopening super-rally
2020-06-26.body: A ~116% surge from mid-2020 through March 2021 as vaccine news and reopening hopes detonated the most COVID-crushed group. Airlines, cruises and hotels led the 'return to normal' trade.
2020-06-26.body_zh: 从2020年中到2021年3月暴涨约116%，随着疫苗消息与重启希望引爆这个受疫情重创最深的板块。航空、邮轮与酒店引领“回归正常”交易。
drivers_zh: 疫苗突破点燃重启希望
受疫情重创最深板块反弹最强

2021-03-15.title: Delta-variant pause
2021-03-15.body: A ~22% pullback into July 2021 as the Delta variant raised reopening doubts and the easy first-leg gains were digested.
2021-03-15.body_zh: 随着Delta变异毒株引发重启疑虑、首段涨幅被消化，该板块到2021年7月回调约22%。
drivers_zh: Delta变异毒株引发重启疑虑
超级反弹后的获利了结

2021-07-19.title: Reopening trade resumes
2021-07-19.body: A ~23% recovery into November 2021 as Delta fears faded and bookings rebounded toward year-end.
2021-07-19.body_zh: 随着Delta担忧消退、预订趋向年末反弹，该板块到2021年11月复苏约23%。

2021-11-05.title: Omicron scare
2021-11-05.body: A sharp ~22% drop into early December 2021 as the Omicron variant emerged and travel bans returned, briefly reviving pandemic fears.
2021-11-05.body_zh: 随着奥密克戎变异毒株出现、旅行禁令重现，短暂重振疫情担忧，该板块到2021年12月初猛跌约22%。
drivers_zh: 奥密克戎变异毒株出现

2021-12-01.title: Omicron-mild relief bounce
2021-12-01.body: A ~23% rebound into mid-February 2022 as Omicron proved milder than feared and reopening confidence returned.
2021-12-01.body_zh: 随着奥密克戎证明比担忧的更轻、重启信心回归，该板块到2022年2月中旬反弹约23%。
drivers_zh: 奥密克戎证明比担忧的更轻

2022-02-16.title: Ukraine and oil-spike shock
2022-02-16.body: A ~25% selloff into early March 2022 as Russia's invasion of Ukraine spiked oil prices, threatening jet-fuel costs and broad risk appetite.
drivers: Oil prices spike, jet-fuel costs threatened
2022-02-16.title_zh: 乌克兰与油价骤升冲击
2022-02-16.body_zh: 随着俄罗斯入侵乌克兰推高油价、威胁喷气燃油成本与整体风险偏好，该板块到2022年3月初下跌约25%。
drivers_zh: 油价骤升，喷气燃油成本受威胁

2022-03-07.title: Oil-pullback bounce
2022-03-07.body: A ~24% rally into late March 2022 as oil prices pulled back from their spike and pent-up spring/summer travel demand reasserted itself.
drivers: Oil prices pull back from the spike
2022-03-07.body_zh: 随着油价从骤升中回落、被压抑的春夏旅游需求重现，该板块到2022年3月下旬反弹约24%。
drivers_zh: 被压抑的春夏旅游需求

2022-03-29.title: Rate-hike bear catches travel
2022-03-29.body: A ~35% slide into the June 2022 bear-market low as aggressive Fed hikes, recession fears and high fuel costs hit the consumer-cyclical group.
2022-03-29.body_zh: 随着美联储激进加息、衰退担忧与高燃油成本冲击消费周期型板块，该板块到2022年6月熊市低点下滑约35%。
drivers_zh: 高燃油成本挤压利润率

2022-06-16.title: Revenge-travel boom
2022-06-16.body: A ~68% surge from the June 2022 low through July 2023. 'Revenge travel' — pent-up demand to fly, cruise and vacation — ran at full throttle even as the Fed kept hiking; pricing power and full planes overwhelmed cost fears.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 从2022年6月低点到2023年7月暴涨约68%。“报复性旅游”——被压抑的乘机、邮轮与度假需求——全力运转，即使美联储持续加息；定价能力与满舱压倒成本担忧。

2023-07-18.title: Yield-spike consumer scare
2023-07-18.body: A ~26% pullback into late October 2023 as the 10-year yield ran toward 5% and fears grew that travel demand had peaked.
2023-07-18.body_zh: 随着10年期收益率趋向5%、担忧旅游需求已见顶，该板块到2023年10月下旬回调约26%。

2023-10-27.title: Soft-landing reopening run
2023-10-27.body: A ~81% advance from the October 2023 low into February 2025. Continued strong experiential spending, the Fed pivot, falling inflation and the 2024 rate cut sustained the travel boom to new highs.
2023-10-27.body_zh: 从2023年10月低点到2025年2月上涨约81%。持续强劲的体验型消费、美联储转向、通胀下行与2024年降息支撑旅游繁荣创新高。

2025-02-19.title: Tariff-shock plunge
2025-02-19.body: A ~34% selloff into the April 8, 2025 low. Recession fears from the reciprocal-tariff crash hit the most consumer-cyclical group hardest — travel is the first budget line to get cut when households brace for a downturn.
drivers: Travel is the first discretionary cut
2025-02-19.body_zh: 从2025年4月8日低点下跌约34%。对等关税暴跌引发的衰退担忧对最具消费周期性的板块打击最重——当家庭为衰退做准备时，旅游是首先被删减的预算项。
drivers_zh: 旅游是首先被删减的可选项

2025-04-08.title: Reopening rally matures into a top
2025-04-08.body: A ~78% rebound off the April 2025 low into June 2026 as tariff fears eased and experiential demand stayed strong, pushing the basket to a topping (pos 78) state. The group is now extended and late-cycle: the 2026 oil shock lifted jet-fuel costs and squeezed the consumer, and the mid-June ceasefire only partially offsets that. Risk/reward has shifted from catch-up to caution.
drivers: Tariff fears ease, demand stays strong
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月低点到2026年6月反弹约78%，随着关税担忧缓解、体验需求保持强劲，该篩子进入见顶（位置78）状态。该板块如今已超买且处于周期末期：2026年石油冲击推高喷气燃油成本并挤压消费者，6月中旬停火仅部分抵消。风险回报已从补涨转向谨慎。
drivers_zh: 关税担忧缓解，需求保持强劲
篩子达到见顶/超买状态
2026年石油冲击推高喷气燃油成本
周期末期消费挤压限制上行空间

defensives.now: Defensives (XLP/XLU-proxied staples, utilities and low-vol cash-flows) sit mid-pack (pos 38, RS rank 24) and are in a slow uptrend. By design this is the boring, safe-haven blend — it lags badly in risk-on melt-ups and shines when fear spikes. The 2026 backdrop is a tug-of-war: the Iran/Hormuz oil shock, hot 4.2% CPI and a hawkish Fed are the kind of macro stress that usually bids defensives, but rising bond yields hurt the rate-sensitive utility leg, and a risk-on AI-led tape has kept money chasing growth instead. The result is a steady-but-unexciting grind. This basket is the portfolio's shock absorber, not its engine — its relative strength tends to improve precisely when the rest of the board cracks.
defensives.now_zh: 防御板块（以XLP/XLU为代理的必需品、公用事业与低波动现金流）处于中游位置（位置38，RS排名24），处于缓慢上升趋势中。按设计，这是枯燥的避险组合——在风险偏好的涨势中严重落后，在恐慌骤升时发光。2026年的背景是一场拉锯战：伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击、达4.2%的CPI与鹰派美联储是通常会拉动防御板块的宏观压力，但上升的债券收益率伤害利率敏感的公用事业腿，而风险偏好、AI主导的行情让资金继续追逐成长。结果是稳定但乏味的震荡上行。这个篩子是组合的减震器而非引擎——其相对强度往往恰恰在板上其余板块出现裂痕时改善。

2022-04-21.title: Even defensives can't escape the 2022 bear
2022-04-21.body: A ~15% drawdown into October 2022. Defensives held up far better than growth, but the rate-hike bear hit everything — rising yields particularly pressured the bond-proxy utility leg even as staples cushioned the blow.
drivers: Rising yields hit the utility leg
2022-04-21.title_zh: 连防御板块也难逃—2022年熊市
2022-04-21.body_zh: 到2022年10月回撤约15%。防御板块表现远优于成长股，但加息熊市冲击了一切——上升的收益率尤其压制作为债券代理的公用事业腿，即使必需品缓冲了打击。
drivers_zh: 加息熊市压制所有资产
上升收益率冲击公用事业腿
必需品相对成长股缓冲

2022-10-07.title: Safe-haven bid into the bottom
2022-10-07.body: A ~21% rally from October 2022 into May 2023. As the bear ended and SVB's March 2023 collapse triggered a flight to safety, defensives caught a steady haven bid and falling yields helped utilities.
drivers: SVB collapse triggers flight to safety
2022-10-07.body_zh: 从2022年10月到2023年5月反弹约21%。随着熊市结束、2023年3月SVB倒闭引发避险情绪，防御板块获得稳定的避险买盘，收益率下行帮助了公用事业。
drivers_zh: 收益率下行帮助公用事业

2023-05-01.title: Defensives lag the AI risk-on
2023-05-01.body: A ~15% drawdown into October 2023 — the textbook defensive curse. As the AI rally and soft-landing optimism pulled money into growth, low-vol staples and utilities were left behind, and the autumn yield spike compounded the pain on the bond-proxy leg.
drivers: AI rally pulls money into growth
2023-05-01.title_zh: 防御板块落后于AI风险偏好
2023-05-01.body_zh: 到2023年10月回撤约15%——教科书式的防御诅咒。随着AI行情与软着陆乐观将资金拉向成长，低波动必需品与公用事业被抛在身后，秋季收益率骤升加剧了债券代理腿的痛苦。
drivers_zh: 防御板块在风险偏好中落后
秋季收益率骤升冲击公用事业
教科书式的低波动跑输

2023-10-12.title: Long, steady defensive grind
2023-10-12.body: A ~43% advance from October 2023 all the way into February 2026 — the basket's defining steady-compounder leg. Defensives ground higher through the soft landing, the rate cuts and the various risk scares; utilities also picked up an AI-power-demand tailwind. This is the slow, low-drama uptrend that defines the blend, and it ran right up to the 2026 oil-shock stress.
drivers: Haven bid through periodic risk scares
Low-drama uptrend into the 2026 oil shock
2023-10-12.title_zh: 漫长稳定的防御震荡上行
2023-10-12.body_zh: 从2023年10月一路上涨至2026年2月，约43%——该篩子决定性的稳定复利腿。防御板块在软着陆、降息与各种风险惊魂中震荡走高；公用事业还获得AI电力需求顺风。这是定义该组合的缓慢、低波动的上升趋势，一直持续到2026年石油冲击压力出现。
drivers_zh: 公用事业获AI电力需求顺风
阶段性风险惊魂中的避险买盘
低波动上升趋势持续至2026年石油冲击

crypto.now: Crypto & digital assets (IBIT-proxied exchanges, miners and bitcoin-treasury names — COIN, MSTR and miners) is trending (pos 35, RS rank 10) and remains the highest-beta theme on the board. Everything here is a leveraged bet on Bitcoin: COIN's volumes, MSTR's BTC stack and miners' economics all swing on the coin. After the late-2025 pullback, the basket put in a strong ~86% rally into June 2026, but it remains a risk-appetite barometer first and foremost. The 2026 oil-shock/hawkish-Fed backdrop is a headwind — high-beta crypto hates rising real rates and a tighter Fed — yet the structural tailwinds (post-halving supply, the maturing spot-ETF complex and corporate treasury adoption) keep the floor higher than in past cycles. Expect this basket to lead on the way up and lead on the way down.
crypto.now_zh: 加密与数字资产（以IBIT为代理的交易所、矿工与比特币财务公司——COIN、MSTR与矿工）处于趋势中（位置35，RS排名10），仍是板上最高beta的主题。这里的一切都是对比特币的杠杆下注：COIN的成交量、MSTR的BTC持仓与矿工的经济性都随币价波动。在2025年底回调后，该篩子到2026年6月强劲反弹约86%，但它首先仍是风险偏好晴雨表。2026年石油冲击/鹰派美联储背景是逆风——高beta加密讨厌上升的实际利率与更紧的美联储——但结构性顺风（减半后的供给、成熟的现货ETF体系与企业财务采纳）让底部高于过往周期。预期这个篩子在上涨时领涨、在下跌时领跌。

2021-02-19.title: First 2021 correction
2021-02-19.body: A ~53% drawdown into May 2021 as the first half of the 2021 bull cycle topped out — China's mining crackdown and an overheated, over-leveraged market triggered a violent high-beta unwind.
2021-02-19.body_zh: 到2021年5月回撤约53%，随着2021年牛市周期上半场见顶——中国挖矿打击与过热、过度杠杆化的市场引发猛烈的高beta去杠杆。
drivers_zh: 过热、过度杠杆化的市场

2021-05-21.title: Run to the November 2021 cycle top
2021-05-21.body: A ~119% surge into November 2021 as the bull cycle made its final blow-off high — ETF optimism, retail mania and peak risk appetite drove COIN and miners to records before the long winter began.
2021-05-21.body_zh: 到2021年11月暴涨约119%，随着牛市周期冲击最后的喷发高点——ETF乐观、零售狂热与峰值风险偏好推动COIN与矿工创下记录，随后漫长的冬季开始。
drivers_zh: 牛市周期最后的喷发高点

2021-11-08.title: Crypto winter begins
2021-11-08.body: A ~66% plunge into January 2022 as the Fed's hawkish pivot and the start of the rate-hike cycle drained liquidity from the highest-beta asset on the board, kicking off the 2022 crypto winter.
2021-11-08.body_zh: 到2022年1月猛跌约66%，随着美联储鹰派转向与加息周期启动，从板上最高beta的资产中抽走流动性，拉开了2022年加密冬季的序幕。
drivers_zh: 美联储鹰派转向抽走流动性

2022-01-27.title: Bear-market relief bounce
2022-01-27.body: A ~57% rebound into late March 2022, a sharp but doomed counter-trend rally typical of a high-beta bear before the deeper leg down.
drivers: Doomed before the deeper leg down
2022-01-27.body_zh: 到2022年3月下旬反弹约57%，这是高beta熊市典型的尖锐但注定失败的逆势反弹，随后出现更深的下跌。

2022-03-29.title: Luna/Terra cascade
2022-03-29.body: A ~74% collapse into June 2022 as the Terra/Luna implosion and the 3AC/Celsius leverage cascade vaporized crypto credit, marking the worst stretch of the winter.
2022-03-29.body_zh: 到2022年6月崩跌约74%，随着Terra/Luna崩塌与3AC/Celsius杠杆连锁崩塌蒸发了加密信贷，标志着冬季最糟糕的阶段。

2022-06-30.title: Post-Luna dead-cat bounce
2022-06-30.body: A ~112% rebound into mid-August 2022 — a violent oversold bounce after the Luna cascade, before the FTX collapse delivered the final blow.
2022-06-30.body_zh: 到2022年8月中旬反弹约112%——Luna崩塌后猛烈的超卖反弹，随后FTX倒闭给出最后一击。

2022-08-12.title: FTX collapse: the winter low
2022-08-12.body: A ~68% plunge into late December 2022 as the November 2022 FTX collapse — the largest crypto fraud and exchange failure on record — destroyed confidence and marked the cycle's washout low.
2022-08-12.body_zh: 到2022年12月下旬猛跌约68%，随着2022年11月FTX倒闭——有记录以来最大的加密欺诈与交易所倒闭——摧毁信心并标志着周期的出清低点。
drivers_zh: 有记录以来最大的交易所倒闭

2022-12-28.title: ETF super-cycle: 12x off the bottom
2022-12-28.body: A staggering ~1220% surge from the December 2022 FTX low through December 2024. The spot-Bitcoin-ETF approval (January 2024), the April 2024 halving, the AI/risk-on backdrop and Trump's pro-crypto November 2024 election win drove the highest-beta basket to a generational run.
drivers: Institutional adoption via the ETF complex
2022-12-28.body_zh: 从2022年12月FTX低点到2024年12月惊人暴涨约1220%。现货比特币ETF获批（2024年1月）、2024年4月减半、AI/风险偏好背景与特朗普支持加密的2024年11月胜选推动这个最高beta的篩子进入一世代级别的上涨。
drivers_zh: 特朗普支持加密的2024年11月胜选

2024-12-06.title: Tariff-shock unwind
2024-12-06.body: A ~53% drawdown into the April 8, 2025 low. Post-election euphoria faded, the DeepSeek AI scare hit risk sentiment, and the April 2025 reciprocal-tariff crash drained risk appetite — high-beta crypto fell hardest.
2024-12-06.body_zh: 从2025年4月8日低点回撤约53%。选后狂欢消退、DeepSeek AI惊魂冲击风险情绪，2025年4月对等关税暴跌抽走风险偏好——高beta加密跌幅最大。

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff crypto surge
2025-04-08.body: A ~246% rally off the April 2025 tariff low into October 2025 as risk appetite roared back, ETF inflows resumed and corporate Bitcoin-treasury adoption (MSTR-style) accelerated, sending COIN and miners sharply higher.
drivers: COIN and miners lead the surge
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税冲击后的加密激增
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月关税低点到2025年10月反弹约246%，随着风险偏好强劲回归、ETF资金流入恢复、企业比特币财务采纳（MSTR式）加速，送COIN与矿工大幅走高。
drivers_zh: 企业比特币财务采纳加速

2025-10-15.title: Late-2025 correction
2025-10-15.body: A ~51% drawdown into February 2026 as the parabolic rally cooled and the building 2026 macro stress — rising rates and the early oil-shock fears — hit the highest-beta basket first.
2025-10-15.body_zh: 到2026年2月回撤约51%，随着抛物线式反弹降温、逐渐积聚的2026年宏观压力——上升的利率与早期石油冲击担忧——首先冲击最高beta的篩子。
drivers_zh: 早期石油冲击宏观压力

2026-02-05.title: Structural-floor rebound
2026-02-05.body: A strong ~86% rebound off the February 2026 low into June. Despite the hawkish oil-shock backdrop, the maturing spot-ETF complex, post-halving supply scarcity and corporate-treasury demand provided a higher floor, and risk appetite snapped back hard off oversold levels.
drivers: Maturing spot-ETF complex provides a floor
2026-02-05.body_zh: 从2026年2月低点到6月强劲反弹约86%。尽管鹰派石油冲击背景存在，成熟的现货ETF体系、减半后的供给稀缺与企业财务需求提供了更高的底部，风险偏好从超卖水平强劲反弹。
drivers_zh: 成熟的现货ETF体系提供底部
